name: Castaway Memories
source:
You are cordially invited to a swanky hot springs resort on a lush tropical island. It'll be nothing but the sun, the sea, the sand, and the seven sketchy amnesiacs who are convinced that getting close to you is the only way to regain their memories. Wait, what was that last part? 

[From [url=https://ghostclown.itch.io/castaway-memories]itch.io[/url]]
